title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 remote code execution was possible via path traversal in the pipeline…
description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7 due to a path traversal issue in the pipeline YAML file path. This flaw allows an attacker with limited privileges to execute arbitrary code remotely by exploiting the path traversal vulnerability.
